_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_zephras_10-15 is written after this band. It starts at Valanaar, where this band exits.

W_XP_RANGE: 62 quests in this band are Zephra's Isle quests with no XP row in data/raw (as in zephras_01-05), so the 22800 XP budget cannot be checked. Pacing is by level range and step count. Re-check in game.

Level 10 starters: Taming the Beast (Hunter, Elayaa Easewind) and Call of Fire (Shaman, Aarnor Galestrike) are in Shen'dar Village and need level 10. The late Shen'dar stop takes them at level 10 on the way south. Other classes skip them at runtime.

Mulgore side trip (98424, 98427): 98427 Ceasing Operations is elite-flagged in the pack, and elite quests may not be dropped (PRD 6.2), so the zeppelin round trip is kept as optional. 98424 is here only because 98427 needs it. Its source item, Mulgore Expansion Plans (281031), comes from Mulgore quests outside this band, so check it in game or cut the side trip.
Elite talks (Desperate Times, A Grand Adventure, Confront Lorthuna) show mob level 9999 in the DB, so their revisitAt values are estimates. Check them in game.
Mulgore and Thunder Bluff drops: 92 quests, all reached only by the isle zeppelin. Zephras_10-15 leaves the isle at about level 12 by that zeppelin, so it can take any of them that its pack keeps.
